title: AccessPafos labelled validation sample
description: A human ground-truth label for one pedestrian segment, paired with the system's belief at the moment of labelling.

trueStatus.description: What a human found to be actually true. 'unverified' is not a valid ground truth: a person standing on the pavement always knows.

trueBarriers.description: Barrier identifiers actually present, from the shared vocabulary.

predictedStatus.description: What the system said at the moment of labelling. 'unverified' means it declined to classify.

assessmentVersion.description: Which version of the scoring engine produced the prediction. Metrics from different versions must not be pooled.
